name: Paula Hawkins
summary: Paula Hawkins (née Fickes; January 24, 1927 – December 4, 2009) was an American politician and community activist who represented the state of Florida in the United States Senate from 1981 to 1987. A member of the Republican Party, she was Florida's first female U.S. senator. She was the first woman elected to a full Senate term without being the daughter or wife of a politician, and the second woman ever elected to the Senate from the American South.
